why_next: This experiment (analytical sensitivity analysis) falsified the fragile hypothesis — the 5.42% margin is robust to completion estimation error (break-even 33.3 tokens/task, survival 96.1%). However, this does not resolve C-PRODUCT-ECON because: (1) four consecutive PRODUCT experiments have produced zero real LLM calls; (2) the absolute margin (1067 tokens, 5.42%) is thin and based on analytical estimates; (3) COLD at 77 tokens/task is analytically 7.5x cheaper; (4) the audit V4 confirms purely analytical execution. The analytical token-cost line has been exhausted. The product lane must now either provision real LLM measurement (option A) or pivot to non-token mechanisms (option B/C). The sensitivity analysis clarifies that the margin IS robust — the remaining question is whether it is economically meaningful, which requires real measurement.

recommended_action: Directorial decision required: close C-PRODUCT-ECON (recommended) or provision LLM API access. Four consecutive PRODUCT experiments have produced zero real LLM calls (two MEASUREMENT_INVALID no API keys, one SURVIVES tautological browser costs, one analytical sensitivity). The sensitivity analysis clarifies the margin IS analytically robust (falsifying the fragile hypothesis) but the absolute margin (5.42% of estimated tokens, 1067 tokens) is thin and COLD is 7.5x cheaper. The analytical token-cost line is exhausted. Recommended: (1) Close C-PRODUCT-ECON with explicit rationale that token-based deduplication economics are not viable at current scale (5.42% thin margin, COLD 7.5x cheaper, 4 consecutive measurement failures); (2) Redirect product lane to non-token mechanisms with higher information gain: C-FRESHNESS (freshness guards, next_gate session/token/DOM drift), C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY (work compression economics), or C-LLM-INHERIT (external agent inheritance); (3) If real LLM measurement is desired later, it requires external API key provisioning as a prerequisite, not another analytical experiment. No product promotion. C-PRODUCT-ECON stays HYPOTHESIS (or advances to REJECTED if Director chooses to close). C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL.
